message:
Running command: cat >/tmp/test.xml <<'EOF'
<!DOCTYPE doc [<!ENTITY ent "<ns:elem/>">]>
<doc><decl1 xmlns:ns="urn:ns1">&ent;</decl1><decl2 xmlns:ns="urn:ns2">&ent;</decl2><decl3 xmlns:ns="urn:ns3">&ent;</decl3></doc>
EOF
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./xmllint --noent /tmp/test.xml >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; rc=$?; echo rc=$rc; cat /tmp/err | head -50; cat /tmp/out
